Product tour

One workspace for every stage of the work

Map the work before you start

Turn scattered notes into a shared plan. Group tasks by milestone, assign owners, and surface dependencies so the whole team sees the same picture from day one.

Planning board

Keep momentum while you build

Track active work in a focused queue. Status, blockers, and recent changes stay in one place, so nobody has to chase an update across three tools.

Active work queue

Review with full context

Comments, change history, and approvals live alongside the work itself. Reviewers see what changed and why, and sign off without leaving the page.

Review panel

Ship and close the loop

Mark work done, notify stakeholders, and roll the outcome back into the next plan. A clean handoff means the next cycle starts from a known state.

Platform capabilities

Built to scale with how your team actually works

One timeline for every workspace

Activity from projects, comments, and integrations lands in a single chronological view. Filter by lane, mute the noise, and keep the whole team reading from the same record without switching tools.

Permissions that match your structure

Assign access per workspace, project, or individual resource. Roles inherit cleanly, exceptions stay visible, and every grant is recorded so an audit never turns into an archaeology project.

Insight without a separate analytics seat

Throughput, response times, and adoption trends render inline on the surfaces you already use. Spot a regression the day it starts instead of in next quarter's review.

How it works

Go from sign-up to first result in three steps

A short, ordered path. Each step builds on the one before it, so the sequence reads top to bottom on any screen.

  1. 1

    Connect your workspace

    Link the tools your team already uses. Read-only access is enough to get started, and you can widen scopes later.

  2. 2

    Set your guardrails

    Choose the rules that matter to you. Defaults are sensible, so most teams keep them and move on.

  3. 3

    Review your first result

    Within minutes you get a summary you can act on. Share it, refine the inputs, or schedule it to run on its own.

Frequently asked

Answers to the questions teams ask before getting started

Most teams complete initial setup in a single afternoon. You connect your data sources, invite your collaborators, and the default workspace is ready to use immediately. Larger rollouts with custom roles typically finish within the first week.

Yes. Guided importers cover the most common spreadsheet and database formats, and a flexible field mapper lets you align your existing structure to the workspace schema. Historical records are preserved with their original timestamps so nothing is lost in the move.

Data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, access is governed by granular role-based permissions, and every administrative action is captured in an immutable audit log. You control where your workspace is hosted and can export or delete your records at any time.

You are notified well before reaching any threshold, and your work is never interrupted. From the same notice you can upgrade in place or schedule a call to review the right plan for your growth. There are no surprise charges and no forced overages.

Every account includes guided onboarding with templates, in-product walkthroughs, and a searchable help center. Teams on annual plans are paired with a dedicated specialist for the first ninety days to make sure the rollout lands smoothly.

Usage pricing

Pay only for what you process

Rates are per million tokens. Cache reads bill at a fraction of standard input, so repeated context stays inexpensive across a session.

Token rates by model tier, in USD per million tokens.
Model tier Input Output Cache write Cache read
Lite Fast, high-volume tasks $0.25 / MTok $1.25 / MTok $0.30 / MTok $0.03 / MTok
